turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m 16 and still haven’t had my first period. I also have severe acne, I’ve had fractures from minor trauma, and at birth they noticed partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “I’ve noticed my skin gets very irritated and sometimes seems raw where I’ve scratched acne, and I do occasionally get small open spots from picking.” “I also use isotretinoin right now, but the acne-related sores still happen from time to time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any episodes where I stop breathing or wake up gasping for air during sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed redness or warmth on my left wrist compared to the other side.” “I do get general skin irritation where I scratch, but not that specific spot.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the skin of your chest), especially after an injury or from coughing/strain?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall, and I don’t get dark or discolored spots after injuries, coughing, or straining.” “I did have fractures from minor trauma, though.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: “No, I haven’t been urinating more than usual or noticed any increase in how much I’m producing.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t used alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs.” “I’m only taking my prescribed isotretinoin and oral contraceptive.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have trouble controlling my urine—I don’t leak and I can usually make it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently, and I haven’t noticed any blood coming from my nose.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: “No, I haven’t noticed a rash on my trunk—just irritation and raw spots on my skin where I scratch or pick at acne.” “Sometimes I get small open spots from picking, but nothing widespread on my chest, back, or belly.”
